title: Vanilla Duplicates
description: Detects content that duplicates vanilla Minecraft files. Unnecessary copies increase pack size and may cause conflicts with game updates.

101.title: Exact Duplicate
101.description: Error when a file is an exact copy of a vanilla Minecraft file. This wastes space and may cause issues when the vanilla file is updated. Remove the duplicate.
101.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the path to the duplicated vanilla file

102.title: Partial Duplicate
102.description: Warning when a file appears to be a mostly-unchanged copy of vanilla content with minor modifications. Consider using only the necessary overrides rather than duplicating the entire file.
102.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the path to the partial duplicate and similarity percentage
